sol_country_demand_check_pivot = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:sol_country_demand_solve_status = 1 }
		sol_country_demand_abs = { source = sol_m_$pivot$_$pivot$ target = sol_pivot_abs_$pivot$ }
		if = {
			# Class rows are normalized to nationwide stratum base, so this is a relative threshold.
			limit = { var:sol_pivot_abs_$pivot$ <= 0.0001 }
			set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_solve_status value = -1 }
		}
	}
}

		set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_solve_status value = -7 }
	}
}

sol_country_demand_run_strategy_5 = {
	sol_country_demand_approx_prepare_strategy = { strategy = 5 }
	# A validated exact solve is a minimax candidate; vertices remain fallback.
	if = {
		limit = { var:sol_country_demand_exact_status = 1 var:sol_approx_total_col_4 > 0.00001 var:sol_country_class_coefficient_1 >= -0.00001 var:sol_country_class_coefficient_2 >= -0.00001 var:sol_country_class_coefficient_3 >= -0.00001 var:sol_country_class_coefficient_4 >= -0.00001 }
		sol_country_demand_approx_reset_kkt = yes
		set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_solve_status value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = sol_reduced_total_remaining value = var:sol_approx_total_target }
		set_variable = { name = sol_delta_1 value = { value = var:sol_country_class_coefficient_1 min = 0 } }
		set_variable = { name = sol_reduced_total_term value = { value = var:sol_approx_total_col_1 multiply = var:sol_delta_1 } }
		change_variable = { name = sol_reduced_total_remaining subtract = var:sol_reduced_total_term }
		set_variable = { name = sol_delta_2 value = { value = var:sol_country_class_coefficient_2 min = 0 } }
		set_variable = { name = sol_reduced_total_term value = { value = var:sol_approx_total_col_2 multiply = var:sol_delta_2 } }
		change_variable = { name = sol_reduced_total_remaining subtract = var:sol_reduced_total_term }
		set_variable = { name = sol_delta_3 value = { value = var:sol_country_class_coefficient_3 min = 0 } }
		set_variable = { name = sol_reduced_total_term value = { value = var:sol_approx_total_col_3 multiply = var:sol_delta_3 } }
		change_variable = { name = sol_reduced_total_remaining subtract = var:sol_reduced_total_term }
		set_variable = { name = sol_delta_4 value = { value = var:sol_reduced_total_remaining divide = var:sol_approx_total_col_4 } }
		set_variable = { name = sol_delta_5 value = 1 }
		sol_country_demand_approx_assess = { strategy = 5 }
	}
	sol_country_demand_minimax_vertex_enumeration = yes
}

sol_country_demand_select_approx_strategy = {
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_selected_strategy value = $strategy$ }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_selected_average_ratio value = var:sol_country_demand_strategy_average_ratio_$strategy$ }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_selected_average_absolute value = var:sol_country_demand_strategy_average_absolute_$strategy$ }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_selected_objective value = var:sol_country_demand_strategy_objective_$strategy$ }
}

sol_country_demand_solve_approximation = {
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_selected_strategy value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_gate_possible value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_selected_objective value = 999999 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_selected_average_ratio value = -999999 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_selected_average_absolute value = -999999 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_strategy_objective_1 value = 999999 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_strategy_gate_1 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_strategy_average_ratio_1 value = -999999 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_strategy_average_absolute_1 value = -999999 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_strategy_objective_2 value = 999999 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_strategy_gate_2 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_strategy_average_ratio_2 value = -999999 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_strategy_average_absolute_2 value = -999999 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_strategy_objective_3 value = 999999 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_strategy_gate_3 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_strategy_average_ratio_3 value = -999999 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_strategy_average_absolute_3 value = -999999 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_strategy_objective_4 value = 999999 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_strategy_gate_4 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_strategy_average_ratio_4 value = -999999 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_strategy_average_absolute_4 value = -999999 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_strategy_objective_5 value = 999999 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_strategy_gate_5 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_strategy_average_ratio_5 value = -999999 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_strategy_average_absolute_5 value = -999999 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_strategy_objective_6 value = 999999 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_strategy_gate_6 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_strategy_average_ratio_6 value = -999999 }
	set_variable = { name = sol_country_demand_strategy_average_absolute_6 value = -999999 }
	if = { limit = { var:sol_country_demand_exact_status != 1 } sol_country_demand_approx_prepare_country = yes }
	# Exact success is adopted directly; only exact failures reach approximation.
	# The wide gate protects the worst raw row and requires positive mean gain.
	# Player countries have two settings: exact and approx (both default enabled).
	# AI countries are hardcoded to NOT solve (performance reasons) and skip all prep work.
	if = {
		limit = { is_human = yes var:sol_country_demand_exact_status != 1 var:sol_country_demand_gate_possible = 1 var:sol_country_demand_anchor_count > 0 }
		if = { limit = { OR = { NOT = { has_global_variable_map = cmm } has_global_variable = sol_solver_human_approx_enabled } }
			sol_country_demand_run_strategy_1 = yes
			sol_country_demand_run_strategy_2 = yes
			sol_country_demand_run_strategy_3 = yes
			sol_country_demand_run_strategy_4 = yes
			sol_country_demand_run_strategy_5 = yes
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:sol_country_demand_strategy_gate_1 = 1 }
		if = { limit = { var:sol_country_demand_strategy_average_ratio_1 > var:sol_country_demand_selected_average_ratio } sol_country_demand_select_approx_strategy = { strategy = 1 } }
		else_if = { limit = { var:sol_country_demand_strategy_average_ratio_1 = var:sol_country_demand_selected_average_ratio }
			if = { limit = { var:sol_country_demand_strategy_average_absolute_1 > var:sol_country_demand_selected_average_absolute } sol_country_demand_select_approx_strategy = { strategy = 1 } }
			else_if = { limit = { var:sol_country_demand_strategy_average_absolute_1 = var:sol_country_demand_selected_average_absolute var:sol_country_demand_strategy_objective_1 < var:sol_country_demand_selected_objective } sol_country_demand_select_approx_strategy = { strategy = 1 } }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:sol_country_demand_strategy_gate_2 = 1 }
